## About

I am a PhD Candidate in the [Department of Political Science](https://polisci.mit.edu){target="_blank"} at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. I currently also work as a part-time Survey Manager at [Survey 160](https://www.survey160.com){target="_blank"}.

I study American politics, with a primary focus on Latino political behavior. My research examines Latino identity as a pan-ethnic category and how diversity within the Latino community shapes political engagement. I also have interests in survey methodology. My research has been published in *Public Opinion Quarterly* and the *Journal of Race, Ethnicity, and Politics*.

Before graduate school, I worked as a campaign pollster at Lake Research Partners and opposition researcher at Spiros Consulting. I graduated with a B.A. in Political Science and a minor in Latin American Studies from Washington University in St. Louis.

In my free time, I love to cook, go to shows, and watch movies. Here's my [last.fm](https://www.last.fm/user/alefrydman){target="_blank"} and [Letterboxd](https://letterboxd.com/alejandrofrydm/){target="_blank"} if you're curious.

Please feel free to [email](mailto:afrydman@mit.edu) if there's anything you want to chat about!
